mapper.select: SELECT ra.id, ra.patient_id, p.name AS patient_name, ra.risk_level, rlc.level_name AS risk_level_name, ra.assessment_date, ra.assessor_id, u.name AS assessor_name, ra.assessment_result, ra.remarks FROM risk_assessment ra LEFT JOIN patient p ON ra.patient_id = p.id LEFT JOIN user u ON ra.assessor_id = u.id LEFT JOIN risk_level_config rlc ON ra.risk_level = rlc.level_code WHERE ra.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO risk_assessment (patient_id, risk_level, assessment_date, assessor_id, assessment_result, remarks) VALUES (#{patientId}, #{riskLevel}, #{assessmentDate}, #{assessorId}, #{assessmentResult}, #{remarks})
